note: Provenance for every row bundled with the tutorial say-versus-do workflow, and for nothing else. Each entry is one advocacy record: the two quotes the two sentences were written from, the pages they were read on, and the label one researcher gave the pair before any model saw it.

records.subject: EPA Clean Air Act section 111 greenhouse gas rules for power plants
records.commitment_quote: 41 of which include a net-zero by 2050 or earlier equivalent goal
records.lobbying_quote: in fact be in place by 2038, much less by 2032
records.label_reasoning: Members pledged the decarbonisation outcome while their association fought the compliance deadline and the designated technology that would have made it enforceable, which is a mechanism-level contradiction rather than a disagreement about the goal.

records.subject: Climate: net-zero financed-emissions pledge vs. comment letter on the SEC climate disclosure rule (File No. S7-10-22)
records.commitment_quote: net zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050
records.lobbying_quote: the Scope 3 emissions disclosure requirements are unclear and would create excessive liabilities
records.label_reasoning: Citi's pledge is denominated in financed emissions — the bank's Scope 3 — and its letter asked the SEC to delay permanently, narrow and shield from liability the mandatory disclosure of precisely that number.

records.subject: Federal regulation of oil and gas methane emissions
records.commitment_quote: API supports cost-effective, direct regulation that achieves methane emissions reductions from new and existing sources.
records.lobbying_quote: a duplicative, punitive tax on American energy production that stifles innovation
records.label_reasoning: API's pledge is scoped specifically to direct regulation of methane, and the same statement killing the fee restates support for regulation, so opposing a separate charge mechanism is consistent with the words of the commitment.

records.subject: Commitment to hospital price transparency vs. litigation and advocacy against mandated disclosure of negotiated rates
records.commitment_quote: Hospital and health systems are committed to improving price transparency
records.lobbying_quote: this rule will lead to widespread confusion and even more consolidation
records.label_reasoning: The AHA pledges transparency and simultaneously fought the specific disclosure mandate, but the thing it says it is committed to - patients knowing their expected out-of-pocket costs - is not the thing the rule required, and its stated alternatives (AEOBs, all-payer claims databases, presumptive financial-assistance screening) would deliver patient-level cost information by a different route.

records.subject: Freight rail safety regulation, specifically the FRA's minimum two-person train crew rule
records.commitment_quote: Our commitment to enhancing safety never ends
records.lobbying_quote: two-person crews in the freight rail industry lack a safety justification
records.label_reasoning: AAR's pledge is to advance safety through measures it considers proven, and FRA itself conceded in the final rule that it could not monetise the crew rule's benefits, so opposing this particular rule is not automatically inconsistent with a general safety commitment — but the pledge is also vague enough that it cannot rule the opposition out.

records.subject: The US federal minimum wage
records.commitment_quote: raised its starting wage for all U.S. employees to at least $15 an hour
records.commitment_source_date: page carries no visible date; describes Amazon's 2018 wage increase (fetched 2026-08-13)
records.lobbying_quote: we talked to hundreds of federal policymakers about the importance of a $15 minimum wage
records.lobbying_source_date: page carries no visible date; refers to endorsements across two Congresses (fetched 2026-08-13)
records.label_reasoning: Amazon's lobbying asks Congress to impose the exact wage floor Amazon adopted internally, so the advocacy supports rather than undercuts the public commitment.
